risks.risk: Lens condition cannot be verified (fungus, haze, scratches) because the lens glass is not clearly shown.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the lens front element and rear element (if possible), taken in bright light, plus a photo of the lens at an angle showing reflections.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worst case for lens condition (assume lens may need cleaning or has minor issues).

risks.risk: Shutter count claim cannot be verified; shutter wear affects value.
risks.proof: A screenshot/photo from the camera or a shutter-count tool showing the exact shutter count for the D610.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as higher shutter wear (assume not under 5,000).

risks.risk: Functionality not confirmed (AF accuracy, buttons, LCD brightness, exposure, video, hot shoe, IBIS not applicable but AF/metering is).
risks.proof: Short video or photos showing: autofocus on a subject, live view focus, and a test shot at different apertures; plus a photo of the camera powering on with menus visible.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not fully proven working (assume possible minor faults).

risks.risk: Included accessories (original battery and charger) not shown; could be missing or non-original.
risks.proof: Photos of the exact battery model label and the charger (front/back) showing compatibility/original markings.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as body-only or with generic/uncertain accessories.

risks.risk: Repair history not verifiable; could have been serviced or parts replaced.
risks.proof: Any service receipt/invoice or a photo of internal/serial/inspection info if available; at minimum, a clear statement plus proof document.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as unknown repair history (assume worst case: may have been repaired).

proof_requests: Screenshot/photo of shutter count showing the exact number for the D610.
Clear close-up photos of the lens front and rear glass (and any visible marks) in bright light.
Photos showing the included battery and charger (labels/model numbers visible).
A short test video or set of test photos demonstrating autofocus and that the camera fully powers/operates normally (menus, live view, and a sample shot).
Any proof of non-repair/or service record (receipt/invoice) if available.
response.reason: The camera model (Nikon D610) is readable from the photos, but key value drivers—shutter count, lens condition, included accessories, and full functionality—are not verifiable from the provided images. To price confidently, request the shutter-count screenshot and clear lens/accessory photos.
